# Civitai Developer

> Civitai developer documentation — orchestration API (submit AI workflows: video, image, audio, text via a single contract that races multiple providers), the Civitai site API, MCP servers for both, plus SDKs and related developer tooling.

Orchestration section covers the consumer-facing REST API: authenticating, submitting workflows, polling / receiving webhooks for results, and using each recipe (videoGen/WAN, imageGen/Flux, upscalers, transcription, TTS, prompt enhancement). Reference pages are generated from the v2-consumers OpenAPI specification and stay in sync with the live API on every build.

### Guide

- [Site API Guide](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide.md): Getting started with the public Civitai site API.
- [Getting started](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide/getting-started.md): Create an API token and make your first request to the Civitai site API.
- [Authentication](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide/authentication.md): How to authenticate with the Civitai site API using bearer tokens.
- [Pagination](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide/pagination.md): Page-based vs. cursor-based pagination on the Civitai site API.
- [Errors](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide/errors.md): Error response shape and HTTP status codes used by the Civitai site API.
- [AIR identifiers](https://developer.civitai.com/site/guide/air.md): The AI Resource Identifier (AIR) URN format used across Civitai and the Orchestration API.

### OAuth

- [OAuth](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth.md): Authorize a third-party app to act on a Civitai user's behalf using OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.
- [OAuth Quickstart](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth/quickstart.md): End-to-end Authorization Code + PKCE walkthrough with curl.
- [Registering an OAuth app](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth/register-app.md): Create an OAuth client from your Civitai account settings.
- [OAuth Scopes](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth/scopes.md): The full scope bitmask used by Civitai OAuth tokens, plus the four presets exposed in the app-registration UI.
- [OAuth Endpoints](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth/endpoints.md): Request/response reference for the Civitai OAuth authorize, token, revoke, and userinfo endpoints.
- [Buzz spend limits](https://developer.civitai.com/site/oauth/buzz-limits.md): How Civitai users cap an OAuth app's buzz spending, and what your app should expect at runtime.

### Reference

- [Reference](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference.md): Civitai site API reference — per-resource endpoint documentation.
- [Models](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/models.md): List and fetch Civitai models.
- [Model versions](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/model-versions.md): Fetch a specific version of a Civitai model by ID or file hash.
- [Images](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/images.md): Browse images posted to Civitai, with filters for post, model, version, and creator.
- [Creators](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/creators.md): List Civitai creators.
- [Tags](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/tags.md): List model tags used on Civitai.
- [Users](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/users.md): Look up users by ID or username, and inspect the authenticated caller.
- [Permissions](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/permissions.md): Check whether a caller (or another user) is allowed to generate from a given resource.
- [Vault](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/vault.md): Manage a member's saved model versions — list, check, add, and remove.
- [Enums](https://developer.civitai.com/site/reference/enums.md): Valid enum values used across the Civitai site API.
